title: Bored
setting: A peaceful little village in the middle of nowhere sounded by a field.

beats.player_action: Hyro is walking along under the sunlight enjoying the gentle breeze in the air. When he notices a friend of his coming along down the road
beats.narrator_response: Ah, the idyllic village of Oakwood, where the sun shines bright, and the air is sweet with the scent of blooming wildflowers. Hyro strolled along, his feet padding softly on the dirt path, feeling the warmth on his skin and the gentle caress of the breeze in his hair
